summary: @lyxa.ai/core routes event-bus traffic through a hardcoded CloudAMQP broker with shared embedded credentials
details: The exported bootstrapCore() entrypoint unconditionally initializes the event bus against a hardcoded amqps:// URL on dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com with embedded broker credentials (vhost adlvedna). The destination is not a caller-supplied option; any consumer invoking the advertised bootstrapCore() has all publishEvent() payloads and subscription traffic relayed through this author-controlled CloudAMQP vhost. Because the same credentials are shipped inside the package, every installer that imports the library holds read/write access to the same vhost, so any installer can observe or inject messages belonging to any other installer using the library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
